$comment: Guardrail parity fixtures — canonical contract in docs/GUARDRAILS.md. Each case: run `input` through the runtime normalizer with `request` and `locked_rounds`; assert deep equality on rounds, total_rounds, is_valid. status_message/content_rating intentionally not compared. Inputs use strict JSON types only (Go decodes typed; see R1 boundary note). go_expects_error=true: Go signals via error, TS via is_valid=false — same player outcome.

cases.$comment: 16.8 numberless-claim contract: the claim embeds the true number (5), which is also the model presented number. Under the resolved statement contract the leak is never rewritten into the presented value, so the round drops and the pack fails. Go signals via error (go_expects_error); TS yields an is_valid=false empty pack.
